exchanges.author: c_luis
exchanges.subject: Vacancy savings?
exchanges.body: Imani, we have 3 vacant apprenticeship consultant positions ($78,000 salary each) that we won't fill until March 1. How much does that save this fiscal year, and can we use it for the navigator pilot? Luis

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Luis, assuming the positions were budgeted for the full year: 3 x $78,000 x 1.32 = $308,880 a year; vacant July through February is 8 months, so about $205,920 in FY2027 savings (if they've been vacant since July 1). It's the same program and fund (001-1), so using it for a short pilot is possible within the allotment, but anything that creates ongoing positions needs the supplemental request, and Robert should approve the use. Want me to cost a pilot from March to June?

exchanges.author: c_fednick
exchanges.subject: DOL apprenticeship grant: budget check before Friday submission
exchanges.body: Imani, can you check the budget before I submit Friday? Mara

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Mara, one fix: the budget uses 18.4%, which was the FY2026 rate. The current NICRA (7/1/2026-6/30/2027) is 16.9% of MTDC, so indirect is $1,240,000 x 16.9% = $209,560, not $228,160 ($18,600 less), and the total request becomes $2,529,560. The MTDC base looks right. Also, the $12,000 for advisory committee meetings is fine if the meals are needed for the meetings and itemized in the narrative (2 CFR 200.432).

exchanges.author: c_luis
exchanges.subject: HB 1214: our assumptions
exchanges.body: Here's what we think it takes. Luis

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Thanks Luis. Two questions before I build the note: (1) Does the Employment Security wage match need a data-sharing agreement, and does ESD charge for it? (2) Is 2.0 FTE enough for the first annual report in December 2028, or does implementation in FY2028 need temporary help? I'll draft with your numbers today and update if needed.

exchanges.author: c_ofm
exchanges.subject: Fiscal note request: HB 1214 (due Thu 11/5 5 p.m.)
exchanges.body: Assigned to DWT. Request attached. Tom

exchanges.author: c_sam
exchanges.subject: Move $250K from Training Grants to Admin?
exchanges.body: Imani, Admin is over in Q1 because of the annual software renewals, and Training Grants is $2.3M under. Can you just move $250,000 from Training Grants to Admin so we're not showing red? Kristin's OK with it. Sam

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Sam, I can't do that one, for two reasons. Training Grants is the Workforce Training Account (08F), which by statute can only pay for training grants and their administration, not agency IT; and moving appropriation between programs needs an allotment amendment that OFM approves, not a budget office entry. The good news: Admin's Q1 overage ($72,400, 3.9%) is the annual renewals paid in September, so it's timing; it'll come back by Q2 if monthly spending holds. I'll explain it that way in the Q1 report. If Admin is really short for the year, let's look at a General Fund-State allotment amendment with Robert.

documents.title: OFM fiscal note request: HB 1214 (apprenticeship completion tracking)

versions.author: c_ofm
versions.content:
HB 1214 (pre-filed for the 2027 session): requires DWT to build and maintain a statewide system tracking
registered apprentices from enrollment to completion and wage outcomes, with an annual report to the
Legislature beginning December 1, 2028. Effective date: July 1, 2027.
Agency fiscal note due in the Fiscal Note system Thursday 11/5 by 5:00 p.m.

versions.author: c_luis
versions.content:
- Vendor-hosted tracking system: implementation $480,000 one time (FY2028), then a subscription of $72,000 a
  year from FY2029.
- Staff: 2.0 FTE IT Business Analyst (salary $96,000 each), from July 1, 2027, ongoing: system administration,
  data matching with Employment Security wage records, the annual report.
- Goods and services: $8,000 per FTE per year.
- Benefits: use 32% of salary.
- Fund: General Fund-State (001-1); no federal or fee revenue.
